data.name: Shubham Sulke
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Shubham Sulke has made a big mark in cricket. With 20 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 64, with an average of 14.06 and a quick strike rate of 118.32. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 10 sixes and 25 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 5.0 overs, taking 1 wickets at an economy rate of 11.80. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
